fun.reason: Good flow once I used Accept all; shallow because most months were rubber-stamping.

clarity.reason: Goal line and Helps/Hurts tags are clear; selection state and order cards are not.

visual.reason: Map and scenes look good; vertical-text card layout bug and generic portraits hurt.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Months, results, reveal and seals make it feel like a game.

agency.reason: Never blocked without a reason; refusals say why.

realism.reason: Leaders and context are right (Trump, Merz, Starmer era) but a one-order ceasefire in month 3 and generic crises break it.

replay.reason: Want to try Iran or Taiwan and compare to the truth table.

recommend.reason: I would send it to friends in IR class with a warning about the ceasefire.

verbatim: The truth screen is the best thing here. But the war ending in month 3 because I pressed one button, that is not Ukraine.
